name: turquoise-eyes-sofa-selfie
image_purpose: face, eye color, sofa texture, and casual outfit reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic overhead sofa selfie of an approved adult woman in a cozy indoor home setting.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair, bright turquoise-blue eyes, natural skin texture, and an opaque loose lavender short-sleeve striped top with a modest neckline and delicate necklace.
prompt.composition_elements: She lies comfortably on an ornate patterned sofa with one arm behind her head, hair fanned naturally around her, face as focal point, smartphone held slightly above. Keep the pose relaxed and non-sexualized.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffused warm indoor window light with soft highlights and gentle shadows, inviting home atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie, portrait 4:5, close-up, natural skin texture, realistic eye reflections, shallow depth of field, high detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair and bright turquoise-blue eyes takes an overhead selfie while comfortably resting on an ornate patterned sofa. She wears an opaque loose lavender striped short-sleeve top with a modest neckline and a delicate necklace. Use warm diffused indoor light, realistic skin, natural hair, and a calm confident expression. No sensualized framing or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, exposed cleavage, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, warped sofa, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
